caseNameFull: Roadway Express, Inc. v. Director, Division of Taxation
attorneys: Nicholas Conover English for appellant., Arthur J. Sills, Attorney General of New Jersey, and Elias Abelson and Jeffrey R. Lowe, Deputy Attorneys General, for appellee.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The motion to dismiss is granted and the appeal is dismissed for want of a substantial federal question.

Mr. Justice Harlan and Mr. Justice White are of the opinion that probable jurisdiction should be noted and the case set for oral argument.
